title: SOC 2 Type II
body: Audited annually, report available under NDA. GDPR and CCPA ready on every plan.

title: Your data stays yours
body: Never pooled, never used to train a public model. Export or delete everything, any time.

title: Encrypted end to end
body: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and field-level redaction for card and health data.

title: Access you control
body: SSO with SAML or OIDC, role-based permissions, and an audit log of every action.
